test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

So far so good

options.text: Not impressed with how things are
Things are going well so far
No improvement in the work being done
Good things can go far away

solution:
The correct answer is **"Things are going well so far"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Here let's look at the given idiom with an example:

__
 
• **So far so good - **used to say that something (such as a project or an activity) has proceeded well or without problems up to the present

 
 
• ***Eg.*** How's the work on your house going?" "There's a lot more to do, but so *far, so good.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here will we look at some other idiom with their meaning:

 
• 
 
**So far so good *(idiom)* - **​​used to say that something (such as a project or an activity) has proceeded well or without problems up to the present

 
 
• 
 
***Eg.*** "How's the work on your house going?" "There's a lot more to do, but *so far, so good."​*
